argv:
import hashlib, json, shutil, tarfile
from pathlib import Path

store = Path("<store>")
deploy_tar = store / "artifacts/20261117-sti108-baseline/deploy.tar"
source_hashes = store / "logs/sti-108-deploy-source-hashes.log"
out_dir = store / "artifacts/20261118-sti119-scanner-preflight/sbom"
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

usage = shutil.disk_usage(store)
assert usage.free >= 25 * 1024**3, f"Insufficient host free space: {usage.free}"

with deploy_tar.open("rb") as stream:
    tar_sha256 = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
assert tar_sha256 == "8b96ae1c0d280cc50b4d1d699d14e4140c6ed81f6f9b4921cbc315ded476de43", tar_sha256
assert deploy_tar.stat().st_size == 1977942016

inventory = {
    item["path"]: item
    for item in map(json.loads, source_hashes.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())
}
rel_root = "images/qemuarm64/firmdura-reference-baseline-qemuarm64-20261117213416.spdx.json"
expected_root = inventory[rel_root]

with tarfile.open(deploy_tar, "r:") as archive:
    raw_root = archive.extractfile("deploy/" + rel_root).read()

raw_root_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(raw_root).hexdigest()
assert raw_root_sha256 == expected_root["sha256"], (raw_root_sha256, expected_root)
assert len(raw_root) == expected_root["size"]

raw_out = out_dir / "baseline-root-raw.spdx.json"
raw_out.write_bytes(raw_root)

print(json.dumps({
    "status": "verified",
    "host_free_bytes": usage.free,
    "host_floor_bytes": 25 * 1024**3,
    "deploy_tar_sha256": tar_sha256,
    "deploy_tar_size": deploy_tar.stat().st_size,
    "raw_root_spdx_member": "deploy/" + rel_root,
    "raw_root_spdx_sha256": raw_root_sha256,
    "raw_root_spdx_size": len(raw_root),
}, indent=2))

argv:
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, urllib.error, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

store = Path("<store>")
feeds_dir = store / "artifacts/20261118-sti119-scanner-preflight/feeds"
feeds_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def fetch_json(url, method="GET", body=None, headers=None):
    hdrs = {"Accept": "application/json", "User-Agent": "firmdura-sti119-preflight/1.0"}
    if headers:
        hdrs.update(headers)
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=hdrs, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            raw = resp.read()
            return {"status_code": resp.status, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "body": json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
        raw = err.read()
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            parsed = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        return {"status_code": err.code, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "body": parsed}

captured_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
grype_release = fetch_json("https://api.github.com/repos/anchore/grype/releases/latest")
grype_db_latest = fetch_json("https://grype.anchore.io/databases/v6/latest.json")
nvd_cve = fetch_json("https://services.nvd.nist.gov/rest/json/cves/2.0?cveId=CVE-2026-19773")
osv_cve = fetch_json("https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/CVE-2026-19773")
ghsa_cve = fetch_json("https://api.github.com/advisories?cve_id=CVE-2026-19773")

snapshot = {
    "captured_at": captured_at,
    "target_cve": "CVE-2026-19773",
    "grype_latest_release": {
        "status_code": grype_release["status_code"],
        "tag_name": grype_release["body"].get("tag_name") if isinstance(grype_release["body"], dict) else None,
        "published_at": grype_release["body"].get("published_at") if isinstance(grype_release["body"], dict) else None,
        "response_sha256": grype_release["sha256"],
    },
    "grype_db_v6_latest": grype_db_latest,
    "nvd_cve_2026_19773": nvd_cve,
    "osv_cve_2026_19773": osv_cve,
    "github_advisories_cve_2026_19773": ghsa_cve,
}

out_path = feeds_dir / "20261118-feed-check.json"
out_bytes = (json.dumps(snapshot, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
out_path.write_bytes(out_bytes)

nvd_vulns = (nvd_cve["body"].get("vulnerabilities") or []) if isinstance(nvd_cve["body"], dict) else []
nvd_cve_obj = nvd_vulns[0]["cve"] if nvd_vulns else {}
print(json.dumps({
    "captured_at": captured_at,
    "snapshot_sha256": hashlib.sha256(out_bytes).hexdigest(),
    "grype_latest_release_tag": snapshot["grype_latest_release"]["tag_name"],
    "grype_latest_release_published_at": snapshot["grype_latest_release"]["published_at"],
    "grype_db_v6_latest_status_code": grype_db_latest["status_code"],
    "grype_db_v6_latest_body": grype_db_latest["body"],
    "nvd_status_code": nvd_cve["status_code"],
    "nvd_vulnStatus": nvd_cve_obj.get("vulnStatus"),
    "nvd_lastModified": nvd_cve_obj.get("lastModified"),
    "nvd_configurations": nvd_cve_obj.get("configurations"),
    "osv_status_code": osv_cve["status_code"],
    "osv_summary": osv_cve["body"].get("id") if isinstance(osv_cve["body"], dict) else osv_cve["body"],
    "ghsa_status_code": ghsa_cve["status_code"],
    "ghsa_count": len(ghsa_cve["body"]) if isinstance(ghsa_cve["body"], list) else None,
}, indent=2))

tmp_dir = art / "grype-tmp"

    "docker", "run", "--rm", "--init", "--read-only", "--network", "none",

    "--user", uid_gid,
    "-e", "GRYPE_DB_CACHE_DIR=/work/grype-db",
    "-e", "GRYPE_CHECK_FOR_APP_UPDATE=false",
    "-e", "TMPDIR=/work/grype-tmp",
    "--mount", f"type=bind,source={art},target=/work,readonly",
    grype_img,
    "db", "status", "-o", "json",
], text=True)

sqlite_path = db_dir / "6/vulnerability.db"
with sqlite_path.open("rb") as f:
    sqlite_sha256 = hashlib.file_digest(f, "sha256").hexdigest()

print(json.dumps({
    "archive_url": url,
    "archive_size": archive_path.stat().st_size,
    "archive_sha256": actual_sha256,
    "sqlite_size": sqlite_path.stat().st_size,
    "sqlite_sha256": sqlite_sha256,
    "db_status": json.loads(status_out),
}, indent=2))

import hashlib, json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

store = Path("<store>")
art = store / "artifacts/20261118-sti119-scanner-preflight"
archive_name = "vulnerability-db_v6.1.10_2026-11-18T00:21:05Z_1794982868.tar.zst"
expected_sha256 = "5029e15a80ebb0ac53cad3413d2768fa241f6e2b71336d8ef73ec5a87e5a4cc0"
archive_path = art / "grype-db" / archive_name

with archive_path.open("rb") as f:
    actual_sha256 = hashlib.file_digest(f, "sha256").hexdigest()
assert actual_sha256 == expected_sha256, (actual_sha256, expected_sha256)

vol = "sti-119-scanner-preflight-20261118"
kas_img = "ghcr.io/siemens/kas/kas@sha256:718b8f0dbf8174645ddb18c7979e7a635a4ed7bd55e750d75c1c8091454b8ce7"
grype_img = "docker.io/anchore/grype@sha256:68205d0d11c88aec5999c3139b04ebc242f8b41c40322d2a56b7e880f1e641b4"
uid = os.getuid()
gid = os.getgid()
uid_gid = f"{uid}:{gid}"

subprocess.run([
    "docker", "volume", "create",
    "--label", "org.firmdura.sample=kirkstone",
    "--label", "org.firmdura.issue=STI-119",
    vol,
], check=True)

# Check Linux disk space and initialize owned directory layout inside the isolated STI-119 volume.
space_json = subprocess.check_output([
    "docker", "run", "--rm", "--init", "--network", "none",
    "--mount", f"type=volume,source={vol},target=/cache",
    kas_img,
    "python3", "-c",
    f"import json, os, pathlib, shutil; "
    f"[pathlib.Path(\"/cache/\" + d).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) for d in (\"db\", \"sbom\", \"outputs\", \"home\", \"tmp\")]; "
    f"[os.chown(\"/cache/\" + d, {uid}, {gid}) for d in (\"\", \"db\", \"sbom\", \"outputs\", \"home\", \"tmp\")]; "
    f"u = shutil.disk_usage(\"/cache\"); "
    f"assert u.free >= 10 * 1024**3, f\"Insufficient Colima VM free space: {{u.free}}\"; "
    f"print(json.dumps({{\"linux_total_bytes\": u.total, \"linux_free_bytes\": u.free}}))",
], text=True).strip()

helper_cid = subprocess.check_output([
    "docker", "create", "--network", "none", "--user", uid_gid,
    "--mount", f"type=volume,source={vol},target=/cache",
    kas_img, "true",
], text=True).strip()
try:
    subprocess.run(["docker", "cp", str(archive_path), f"{helper_cid}:/cache/tmp/{archive_name}"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["docker", "cp", str(art / "sbom/baseline-root-raw.spdx.json"), f"{helper_cid}:/cache/sbom/baseline-root-raw.spdx.json"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["docker", "cp", str(art / "sbom/baseline-consolidated-normalized.spdx.json"), f"{helper_cid}:/cache/sbom/baseline-consolidated-normalized.spdx.json"], check=True)
finally:
    subprocess.run(["docker", "rm", "-f", helper_cid], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)

# Offline import of the verified 2026-11-18 DB archive.
subprocess.run([
    "docker", "run", "--rm", "--init", "--read-only", "--network", "none",
    "--user", uid_gid,
    "--mount", f"type=volume,source={vol},target=/cache",
    "--env", "HOME=/cache/home",
    "--env", "TMPDIR=/cache/tmp",
    "--env", "GRYPE_CHECK_FOR_APP_UPDATE=false",
    "--env", "GRYPE_DB_AUTO_UPDATE=false",
    "--env", "GRYPE_DB_CACHE_DIR=/cache/db",
    grype_img,
    "db", "import", f"/cache/tmp/{archive_name}",
], check=True)

db_status_raw = subprocess.check_output([
    "docker", "run", "--rm", "--init", "--read-only", "--network", "none",
    "--user", uid_gid,
    "--mount", f"type=volume,source={vol},volume-subpath=db,target=/cache/db,readonly",
    "--mount", f"type=volume,source={vol},volume-subpath=tmp,target=/cache/tmp",
    "--mount", f"type=volume,source={vol},volume-subpath=home,target=/cache/home",
    "--env", "HOME=/cache/home",
    "--env", "TMPDIR=/cache/tmp",
    "--env", "GRYPE_CHECK_FOR_APP_UPDATE=false",
    "--env", "GRYPE_DB_AUTO_UPDATE=false",
    "--env", "GRYPE_DB_CACHE_DIR=/cache/db",
    grype_img,
    "db", "status", "-o", "json",
], text=True)

version_raw = subprocess.check_output([
    "docker", "run", "--rm", "--init", "--read-only", "--network", "none",
    "--user", uid_gid,
    grype_img,
    "version", "-o", "json",
], text=True)

print(json.dumps({
    "volume": vol,
    "space_before": json.loads(space_json),
    "archive_sha256": actual_sha256,
    "archive_size": archive_path.stat().st_size,
    "grype_version": json.loads(version_raw),
    "grype_db_status": json.loads(db_status_raw),
}, indent=2))

try:

finally:

# Verify exported files exist and compute SHA-256 before removing temporary volume.

for rel in (

assert "grype-db/6/vulnerability.db" in exported, exported

from collections import Counter
import json, shutil, sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

store = Path("<store>")
art = store / "artifacts/20261118-sti119-scanner-preflight"

raw_scan = json.loads((art / "scans/baseline-root-raw-grype.json").read_text())
norm_scan = json.loads((art / "scans/baseline-consolidated-normalized-grype.json").read_text())
all_scan = json.loads((art / "scans/baseline-consolidated-normalized-all-grype.json").read_text())

def summarize_scan(report):
    matches = report.get("matches", [])
    ignored = report.get("ignoredMatches", [])
    by_pkg = Counter(m["artifact"]["name"] for m in matches)
    by_sev = Counter(m["vulnerability"]["severity"] for m in matches)
    vuln_ids = sorted({m["vulnerability"]["id"] for m in matches})
    lws_matches = [
        {
            "id": m["vulnerability"]["id"],
            "severity": m["vulnerability"]["severity"],
            "namespace": m["vulnerability"]["namespace"],
            "artifact_id": m["artifact"]["id"],
            "artifact_name": m["artifact"]["name"],
            "artifact_version": m["artifact"]["version"],
            "cpes": m["artifact"].get("cpes", []),
        }
        for m in matches
        if "libwebsockets" in m["artifact"]["name"]
    ]
    return {
        "source": report.get("source"),
        "match_count": len(matches),
        "ignored_match_count": len(ignored),
        "unique_vulnerability_count": len(vuln_ids),
        "cve_2026_19773_present": "CVE-2026-19773" in vuln_ids,
        "cve_2026_19773_in_ignored": any(m["vulnerability"]["id"] == "CVE-2026-19773" for m in ignored),
        "matches_by_package": dict(sorted(by_pkg.items())),
        "matches_by_severity": dict(sorted(by_sev.items())),
        "libwebsockets_matches": lws_matches,
    }

# Query SQLite vulnerability.db read-only for CVE-2026-19773 and libwebsockets
db_path = art / "grype-db/6/vulnerability.db"
conn = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{db_path}?mode=ro", uri=True)
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
tables = [r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=\x27table\x27 ORDER BY name")]

vuln_rows = [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
    "SELECT id, name, status, published_date, modified_date, provider_id FROM vulnerability_handles WHERE name = ?",
    ("CVE-2026-19773",),
)]
vuln_ids_db = [r["id"] for r in vuln_rows]

aff_pkgs = []
aff_cpes = []
if vuln_ids_db:
    qmarks = ",".join("?" for _ in vuln_ids_db)
    aff_pkgs = [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        f"""
        SELECT vh.name AS vuln_name, vh.provider_id, os.name AS os_name, os.major_version, os.minor_version,
               pkg.ecosystem, pkg.name AS pkg_name, aph.blob_id
        FROM affected_package_handles aph
        JOIN vulnerability_handles vh ON vh.id = aph.vulnerability_id
        LEFT JOIN operating_systems os ON os.id = aph.operating_system_id
        LEFT JOIN packages pkg ON pkg.id = aph.package_id
        WHERE aph.vulnerability_id IN ({qmarks})
        ORDER BY vh.provider_id, os.name, os.major_version, pkg.name
        """,
        vuln_ids_db,
    )]
    aff_cpes = [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        f"""
        SELECT vh.name AS vuln_name, vh.provider_id, c.part, c.vendor, c.product, c.edition, c.target_software
        FROM affected_cpe_handles ach
        JOIN vulnerability_handles vh ON vh.id = ach.vulnerability_id
        JOIN cpes c ON c.id = ach.cpe_id
        WHERE ach.vulnerability_id IN ({qmarks})
        """,
        vuln_ids_db,
    )]

lws_cpes_in_db = [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
    """
    SELECT DISTINCT vh.name AS vuln_name, vh.provider_id, vh.status, c.part, c.vendor, c.product
    FROM affected_cpe_handles ach
    JOIN vulnerability_handles vh ON vh.id = ach.vulnerability_id
    JOIN cpes c ON c.id = ach.cpe_id
    WHERE c.product = ?
    ORDER BY vh.name
    """,
    ("libwebsockets",),
)]
conn.close()

summary = {
    "host_free_bytes": shutil.disk_usage(store).free,
    "raw_root_scan": summarize_scan(raw_scan),
    "consolidated_normalized_scan": summarize_scan(norm_scan),
    "consolidated_normalized_all_suppressions_scan": summarize_scan(all_scan),
    "db_tables": tables,
    "db_cve_2026_19773_vulnerability_handles": vuln_rows,
    "db_cve_2026_19773_affected_packages": aff_pkgs,
    "db_cve_2026_19773_affected_cpes": aff_cpes,
    "db_all_libwebsockets_cpes": lws_cpes_in_db,
}
(art / "scans/sti-119-analysis-summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))

import copy, hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "scripts/vex")
import normalize_spdx

store = Path("<store>")
deploy_tar = store / "artifacts/20261117-sti108-baseline/deploy.tar"
art = store / "artifacts/20261118-sti119-scanner-preflight"
sti108_evidence = json.loads(Path("evidence/20261117-sti108-baseline/run.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
host_prefix = chr(47) + "Users" + chr(47)

def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        return hashlib.file_digest(f, "sha256").hexdigest()

sbom_path = art / "sbom/baseline-consolidated-normalized.spdx.json"
manifest_path = art / "sbom/baseline-normalization-manifest.json"
replay_bytes, replay_manifest = normalize_spdx.normalize_image_spdx(
    deploy_tar=deploy_tar,
    expected_deploy_tar_sha256="8b96ae1c0d280cc50b4d1d699d14e4140c6ed81f6f9b4921cbc315ded476de43",
    expected_package_count=39,
)
assert replay_bytes == sbom_path.read_bytes(), "Non-deterministic consolidated SPDX output"
replay_manifest_bytes = (json.dumps(replay_manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
assert replay_manifest_bytes == manifest_path.read_bytes(), "Non-deterministic normalization manifest"
assert host_prefix not in sbom_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert host_prefix not in manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

sbom_doc = json.loads(replay_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
lws_files = [f for f in sbom_doc["files"] if f["SPDXID"] == "SPDXRef-PackagedFile-libwebsockets18-1"]
assert len(lws_files) == 1
lws_checksums = {c["algorithm"]: c["checksumValue"] for c in lws_files[0]["checksums"]}
assert lws_files[0]["fileName"] == "usr/lib/libwebsockets.so.18"
assert lws_checksums["SHA256"] == "77809db0b9f6a1f97917292a5976e332de130bed90c21eb219e8032cfe3ae05a"

raw_report = json.loads((art / "scans/baseline-root-raw-grype.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
norm_report = json.loads((art / "scans/baseline-consolidated-normalized-grype.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
for report in (raw_report, norm_report):
    cfg = report["descriptor"]["configuration"]
    assert cfg["vex-documents"] == []
    assert cfg["add-cpes-if-none"] is False
    assert not cfg["distro"]
    assert cfg["db"]["auto-update"] is False
    assert cfg["db"]["validate-by-hash-on-start"] is True
    assert cfg["db"]["validate-age"] is True
    assert len(cfg["ignore"]) == 4
    assert report["descriptor"]["version"] == "0.122.0"
    assert report["descriptor"]["db"]["status"]["built"] == "2026-11-18T06:21:08Z"
    assert report["descriptor"]["db"]["status"]["valid"] is True

cfg_raw = copy.deepcopy(raw_report["descriptor"]["configuration"])
cfg_norm = copy.deepcopy(norm_report["descriptor"]["configuration"])
del cfg_raw["file"], cfg_norm["file"]
assert cfg_raw == cfg_norm

verified_sti108 = 0
for item in sti108_evidence["artifacts"]:
    if "archive_member" in item:
        continue
    prefix = "local://firmdura-kirkstone/"
    p = store / item["locator"][len(prefix):]
    assert p.stat().st_size == item["size"], p
    assert sha256(p) == item["sha256"], p
    verified_sti108 += 1

print(json.dumps({
    "status": "verified",
    "deterministic_consolidated_spdx_sha256": sha256(sbom_path),
    "deterministic_manifest_sha256": sha256(manifest_path),
    "library_file_sha256_preserved": lws_checksums["SHA256"],
    "controlled_scanner_configuration_equal": True,
    "deploy_tar_sha256_after": sha256(deploy_tar),
    "sti108_durable_files_verified_unchanged": verified_sti108,
}, indent=2))

unblock_requirements: External feed enrichment: NVD adds CPE 2.3 applicability configurations for CVE-2026-19773 covering libwebsockets 4.2.2 and Anchore publishes a Grype v6 DB snapshot ingesting that affected_cpe_handles row.

Alternatives considered at the time were waiting for NVD and Grype enrichment, using a Git-commit/Vanir companion or labelled auxiliary feed to test OpenVEX handling, or selecting another Linux-applicable Kirkstone CVE with non-distro CPE coverage.

resolved_observations.observation: Escaped quote inside inline Python string failed syntax check; corrected to os.getuid()/os.getgid() in retry.
Archive downloaded and SHA-256 verified on host, then Colima rejected direct host bind mount of <store> (expected VM isolation); switched to isolated Docker volume staging via docker cp.

Fresh Docker volume root was owned by 0:0 while kas:4.8 defaults to non-root builder user; initialized directory ownership once as 0:0 before dropping to 501:20 for all staging, DB import, and offline scans.

limitations: STI-119 was blocked on upstream feed metadata at this point. Unfiltered Grype 0.122.0 with DB v6.1.10 (2026-11-18T06:21:08Z) reported 0 matches for CVE-2026-19773.

The 151 full-image CPE matches (including Win32-only CVE-2025-1866 on libwebsockets18, libwebsockets-evlib-uv, and libwebsockets-testapps) are version/CPE scanner candidates, not proof of runtime exploitability on this minimal Poky configuration.

Grype 0.122.0 OpenVEX subcomponent matching supports package PURLs only; because Yocto Kirkstone create-spdx.bbclass emits CPEs without PURLs and normalize_spdx.py does not fabricate PURLs, STI-113 OpenVEX statements must bind to the rootfs-SHA-256-qualified image product PURL.

This pass used the baseline deploy.tar read-only. The patched image had not been built. Normalization and positive/negative VEX controls on the frozen STI-110 image pair were still pending under STI-113.
Durable artifacts reside on the approved single-host local store, not an off-host backup or public release asset.
